_comment: Seeded schema profile for the Redis Exporter dashboard (Grafana 11835). Controls are chained and metric-scoped on redis_up: namespace -> pod_name(scoped) -> instance(scoped) (ISSUE-001). 'instance' must resolve to service.instance.id because that is the field co-occurring with redis_up (issue #163 / ISSUE-006); namespace and pod stay as-is.
